import html # Pre‑defined HTML template with placeholders for the invitation data. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}
{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def build_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, details_of_event: str, when_event_is: str, extra_event_info: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title_of_event : str The name or heading of the event. details_of_event : str An extensive description of the event (may contain newlines). when_event_is : str The date on which the event is scheduled. extra_event_info : str Any additional information or instructions supplied by the user. Returns ------- str A fully sanitized HTML string ready to be served. """ # Escape all user‑supplied content to neutralise any HTML or script injection. safe_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(details_of_event, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(when_event_is, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(extra_event_info, quote=True) # Populate the template safely. invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes ) return invitation_html.strip()
